subject: standardization of coeff-SEM with mixed continous and categorical variables

messages.author: 6fa0a18ad6703c6b
messages.subject: standardization of coeff-SEM with mixed continous and categorical variables
parts:
Hello to all, 
I am running a SEM (lava an) with both continous and categorical variables (mostly dummy ones). No latent variables. I was wondering whether I could use standardized coefficients even though it is seems not appropriate for categorical variables. i do not know what to do considering teh continuous variables do not have the same unit.
Thank you for your help, Aline

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: standardization of coeff-SEM with mixed continous and categorical variables
parts: I was wondering whether I could use standardized coefficients even though it is seems not appropriate for categorical variables

They are still the coefficients in units of SD, but I agree that may not be meaningful for dummy codes.  You could turn your continuous variables into z scores, then fit the model again.  The SEs and tests would be incorrect, but you would have standardized coefficients, yet the dummy codes would remain 0-1 metric, so the coefficients would be standardized mean differences.
